div.div: طَبِيخَةُ الحَرِّ , (A, L,) pl. طَبَائِخُ, (S, A, L, K,) (tropical:) Hot wind (S, A, L, K) blowing at midday in the season of vehement heat. (A, L.) One says, خَرَجُوا فِى طَبِيخَةِ الحَرِّ, and فى طَبَائِخِهِ, (tropical:) They went forth during the hot wind &c., and during the hot winds &c. (A.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
